scope: training-source development protocol only; no held evaluation, RL success or clinical station claims

label_policy.C: any actual acquisition in the original same-source Gate 2 window, nearest native row within 2.5 mm, ties lower, no gap fill or extrapolation
label_policy.V: exists one C frame with distinct clean exact singleton echoes for all required roles
label_policy.opportunities: raw same-source window nonempty; mask used for scoring, not features or fit selection
label_policy.macro_f1: all five classes, zero F1 when both truth and predicted positive counts are zero

funnel_scope: joint counts on scheduled four-frame station tapes, not continuous tracking or RL success; world error uses first truly complete frame and frozen certificate uses all four online estimates
certification_scope: frozen whole-segment verifier applied descriptively on the chosen balanced cohort; no rank coverage or conditional risk guarantee claimed

shared_geometry_provenance.coordinate_frame: neutral SMPL-X world XYZ mm; y is longitudinal

bodyparts3d_right.support_policy: archived sampled/interpolated centers and links; gaps remain NaN/False

bodyparts3d_left_mirrored.support_policy: archived sampled/interpolated centers and links; gaps remain NaN/False

medseg_right.support_policy: archived sampled/interpolated centers and links; gaps remain NaN/False

provenance.episode_seed_derivation: first 8 SHA-256 bytes (big endian) of episode_id; no retries or culling

shared_height_control.definition: same raw source and start height with different scheduled requests; independent tapes, not paired intervention
